item.description:
Added

  • About tab — app version plus Send Feedback and the support email now live in their own dashboard tab (moved out of Settings)

Fixed

  • Duplicate default presets no longer appear after turning on iCloud sync on a second Mac; any existing duplicates are reconciled automatically on launch

Added

  • iCloud sync (Pro): completed cycle history and presets sync across Macs via the user's iCloud account. Off by default; toggle in the Pro tab (applies after restart). Running timers stay per-device.
  • Cloister Pro lifetime license — activation, validation with a 14-day offline grace window, and deactivation via Lemon Squeezy (dedicated Pro tab)
  • Menu bar progress ring (emerald focus / gold break) with a configurable display mode: ring, time, or both
  • Explicit SwiftData schema versioning with an automatic pre-migration store backup (last 3 backups kept)
  • Send Feedback — a Help-menu item and a Settings ▸ Support row that open a pre-filled email to support (including your app and macOS version)

Changed

  • Runs as a dynamic menu-bar agent; app bundle renamed to Cloister.app
  • Default keyboard shortcuts moved to the conflict-safe ctrl+opt+cmd chord
  • Minimum supported macOS lowered from 26.2 to 15 (Sequoia)

Fixed

  • Menu bar popover now dismisses on outside click
  • Menu bar popover colors stay stable across app states
  • Long break no longer arrives a session early when an earlier focus session was left paused for hours (for example, running overnight)
